census.note: Context only: street trees are drawn from the NYC Street Tree Census (2015) and are not counted as obstructions in the sun hours (canopies are seasonal and porous). Canopy size is estimated from trunk diameter; the census does not record crown size. 79 census trees that the current NYC Parks inventory lists as removed (stump, retired or dead) are left out.
